purpose: Explicit local review selection only. Does not apply, merge, approve, resolve, delete, or authorize any decision or operational action.

reviewContext.meaning: Optional user-written review context only. Not approval, authentication, authorization, or a change to any source fact.

comparison.fingerprintMeaning: SHA-256 measured over the exact loaded comparison file bytes, not a declared source hash. Identifies bytes only; not authenticity, integrity against a trusted source, shared history, or authorization.

selectionMeaning: Only the listed records were explicitly selected. Omitted records are not implicitly approved, rejected, or resolved. Missing incoming snapshots are absence, not deletion instructions.
